title: Swallowed Stones
html:
The Dark Witch fuses small gems into bigger ones, but past two carats the new stone cracks as it cools. She knows what would hold it together, and she wants someone else to fetch it.

About

Given byDark Witch
Level30
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points3

What you need

  • Gizzard Stone ×8
  • Traitors Gizzard Stone ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Dark Witch (inside Dark Witch Hut (around 1033, -42)) to get the quest.
  2. Hear the Dark Witch out inside Dark Witch Hut
  3. Bring the Dark Witch 8 gizzard stones from the Ogre Den ogres (8) - Gizzard Stone inside Dark Witch Hut
    Kill the Ogre Traitor on the Ogre Den's bottom floor inside Ogre Den
    Bring the Dark Witch the Traitor's gizzard stone - Traitors Gizzard Stone inside Dark Witch Hut

Rewards

Reward
Gold2,000
Character XP80,000
Quest points3

What Dark Witch says

Dark Witch: Ogres swallow anything that shines. Coins and buckles, and a lot of gravel, because they can't tell the difference.

Dark Witch: A stone that rides in an ogre's gut long enough comes out ground smooth and packed hard. That kind holds together in the acid.

Dark Witch: There's an ogre den southwest of Binxonia. Bring me eight of those stones.

Dark Witch: And the one they call the Traitor, down on the bottom floor. He's swallowed more than the rest of them put together. I want his.

Dark Witch: Eight, and his. Look at this one. It's cracked right through and it still won't come apart.

Dark Witch: That's what I was missing. Bring me three gems of one kind at two carats and I'll fuse them into one at two and a half.

Dark Witch: Five thousand gold a time. You know what those stones cost to get.

Handing it in

"Bring me your two-carat gems."
